# Alec

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Last P28](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0028), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P12](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Alec is noted for his attractive appearance. He possesses lovely, curly, black hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)_

## Personality

Alec possesses a good-tempered demeanor along with distinctive curly black hair. He is also skilled in the operation and maintenance of the lighthouse, understanding its care thoroughly.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)_

## Traits

- good-tempered  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)</sub>

## Abilities

- understands attending to the lighthouse (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Alec was married to his wife after she made up her mind to marry him, without him ever knowing how it happened. He later fetched [Janet](../character/janet.md) following the death of John Douglas's mother.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P12](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0012)_

## Relationships

### [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alec and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) are rivals who compete as suitors for [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's affection. This rivalry has been ongoing since Volume 3, placing them in direct competition with one another for her hand.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)_

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

Alec is romantically involved with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) as one of her suitors starting in Volume 3. He accompanies her during her stay in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), where she takes time to visit her birthplace and her parents' grave.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), +4 more_
